description: FREE. Exact length of one post for X, Bluesky, Farcaster, Mastodon or Threads (Meta), in that network's own unit, with the limit, remaining and whether it fits. X: weighted, CJK and emoji count 2, every link 23, limit 280. Bluesky: 300 graphemes and 3000 bytes. Farcaster: UTF-8 bytes, 320 per cast (1024 long cast). Mastodon: 500, links 23. Threads (Meta): 500, emoji count as their UTF-8 bytes. Use it before posting; if it does not fit, check_post_length returns a shortened version and split_thread a thread.

limit.description: Optional limit; default is the network's own limit

network.description: Target network: x (X/Twitter, default), bluesky, farcaster, mastodon or meta-threads (Threads by Meta)

name: count_post_length
title: Count a post's length the way the network counts it (free)
